# Freshworks

> > Freshworks provides AI-powered enterprise software for IT service management (ITSM), customer service, and sales, featuring products like Freshservice, Freshdesk, Freshsales Suite, and Freddy AI automation.

Freshworks offers cloud-based business software solutions that leverage machine learning and AI to streamline IT operations, customer support, and CRM workflows. The platform includes an extensive marketplace of integrations with enterprise tools like Azure AD, AWS, JIRA, and Asana, serving businesses, MSPs, and enterprise teams.

## Key Topics

- Freshservice - IT Service Management platform
- Freshdesk - Customer service and support software
- Freddy AI - AI-powered automation and intelligence
- ITSM - IT Service Management best practices
- AI workflow automation and AIOps
- Freshworks Marketplace - Apps and integrations
- Azure AD and SCIM provisioning
- Incident and alert management
- Machine learning for service operations
- Freshsales Suite - CRM and sales automation
- Freshchat - Customer messaging platform
- Ticket and service request management
- MSP solutions and business team tools
- AI transparency and ethics
- Enterprise integrations and APIs

## Marketplace Integrations

- [Freshworks Azure active directory provisioning (SCIM) Integration | Freshworks Marketplace](https://www.freshworks.com/apps/azure_active_directory_provisioning_scim): Azure AD SCIM provisioning for automated Freshservice user management
- [Freshworks Azure AD - Orch Integration | Freshworks Marketplace](https://www.freshworks.com/apps/azure_ad_-_orch): Azure AD workflow automation and user tracking integration for Freshservice
- [Freshworks AWS Cloud Management Integration | Freshworks Marketplace](https://www.freshworks.com/apps/aws_cloud_discovery): AWS cloud resource discovery and management integration for Freshservice
- [Freshworks JIRA Freshdesk integration Integration | Freshworks Marketplace](https://www.freshworks.com/apps/atlassian_jira_30820): JIRA integration by IntegrateCloud for Freshdesk issue tracking
- [Freshworks Azure DevOps-FreshService Connector FREE Integration | Freshworks Marketplace](https://www.freshworks.com/apps/azure_devops_integration_free): Free Azure DevOps connector by IntegrateCloud for Freshservice integration
- [Freshworks Asana for Freshdesk Integration | Freshworks Marketplace](https://www.freshworks.com/apps/asana_connect): Asana task sync integration connecting Freshdesk tickets to Asana tasks
- [Freshworks AnyDesk Remote Access Integration | Freshworks Marketplace](https://www.freshworks.com/apps/anydesk_remote_access): AnyDesk remote access and screen sharing integration for Freshservice
